description: SPEC §6.7 E8 on Twin Roots, in round 5 (the storm at ×1.2): both Heartcaps stand at 100, the general's of 3600, and each side takes a lane on the first tick. Your Rootbreakers deal 100 × 18 × 1.2 = 2160, capped at the round's fixed 750 (#68), and its Capguards 100 × 6 × 1.2 = 720, under the cap. Both Heartcaps reach 0 in the same round, so the general wins by Rout, though you won the round. Merging is off.
